department: Department of Chemical and Biomolecular Engineering (College of Chemistry)

gre_general.value: The GRE is no longer considered for admission.
gre_general.quote: CBE will no longer consider it for admission.

gre_subject.quote: Do I need to take a Subject (e.g., Engineering or Chemistry) GRE exam? | CBE will no longer consider it for admission.

supervisor.value: You apply to the department, not a professor; advisors are chosen after entry.
supervisor.quote: Students apply to the department, rather than to a professor, and decisions are made on overall qualifications, independent of research interest.

funding.value: Admitted PhD students get a stipend for the whole degree via teaching and/or research assistantships, given satisfactory progress.
funding.quote: Students admitted to our PhD graduate program receive a stipend for the duration of study in the form of teaching and/or research assistantships as long as they are in residence and demonstrate satisfactory progress toward the degree.

entry_route.value: Applicants come from undergraduate study; research experience in the last 2 years of the bachelor's is expected.
entry_route.quote: evidence of superior performance and research experience in the last 2 years of undergraduate studies

notes: International applicants invited to interview have recently had a GPA of 3.7/4.0 or higher (department FAQ).
